The '''private office''' of [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] and [[First Chairman/Legends|First Chairman]] of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]], was located in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]]. Located in the private family wing of the palace, Organa's office was a plush, expansive room.<ref name="SWI145">{{InsiderCite|145|Constant Spirit (short story)}}</ref> It was composed of several sections and was capacious enough to accommodate at least a dozen guests. Its main section contained the viceroy's desk, a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], several [[Couch/Legends|couches]] and a skylight.<ref name="PLD">{{Tales|11|The Princess Leia Diaries}}</ref> One the office's [[Window/Legends|windows]] looked onto the [[Aldera lake]],<ref name="SWI145" /> and another, located just behind the desk, onto the inner city area.<ref name="PLD" /> In the wake of the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Organa had his office upgraded to highest security.<ref name="MoD" />
